# CloutHook

CloutHook is a premium AI short-form video SaaS that turns one raw take into a studio-grade vertical short (1080×1920, up to 60fps). Record once and CloutHook auto-edits, captions, adds b-roll, generates faceless or photoreal-avatar videos, auto-clips long footage into ranked shorts, and posts straight to every major platform.

## What it does
- Record once → auto-edited studio short: cleanup, captions, b-roll, and stitching from a single raw take.
- Faceless videos: script → TTS voice → AI scenes → karaoke captions.
- Photoreal "clone yourself" AI avatar from a recording or photo (record on your phone via a QR hand-off).
- Auto-reframe 16:9 → 9:16 with face and subject tracking.
- Auto-clip a long video into ranked shorts.
- Direct posting to X, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, and TikTok.
- Bring-your-own ElevenLabs voice plus voice cloning.
- Affiliate program with 30% recurring commission.

## Pricing and tokens
- 1 token = 1 AI scene; an animated scene = 3 tokens; a photoreal avatar video = 8 tokens (Creator plan, up to 20/month).
- Free $0/mo (25 tokens) · Base $30/mo (200 tokens) · Creator $79/mo (560 tokens). No per-seat fees.
